A glimpse into my creative work through personal exploration

Florals

My love for beautiful spaces and florals inspired me to create Zahra Blooms Decor: a small business dedicated to transforming spaces through floral-inspired decor. What began as a personal passion for styling, creativity, and thoughtful details grew into a way for me to share that passion with others and help bring warmth, beauty, and character into their spaces.

Zahra means “rose” in Arabic 🌹

Check out more of my work on my Instagram

@zahrabloomsdecor

Artwork

Visual art has been a creative outlet of mine for as long as I can remember. I studied art throughout high school and have continued to pursue it as a hobby ever since. What I enjoy most is the process of turning an idea into something tangible and seeing it come together piece by piece.

Photography

My love for photography began through travel and a deep appreciation for nature. Exploring new places taught me to notice the small details, changing landscapes, and fleeting moments that often go unnoticed. Photography allows me to preserve those experiences and tell stories through a different lens. Whether I'm capturing a breathtaking view, a quiet moment, or the beauty of everyday life, I enjoy creating images that evoke emotion and serve as lasting reminders of the places, people, and memories that shape us.
